en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large brick institutional complex with multiple connected buildings in a simple historicist style. The structures are three to four stories high with steep tiled roofs, chimneys, and arched windows. In the foreground is an open courtyard or parade ground; a small group of uniformed people, likely soldiers or cadets, stand in formation near one entrance. The overall scene suggests a barracks, military academy, or similar government facility. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
